assessment.label: unbalance
assessment.reason: Query shows strongly elevated shaft 1x on all 4 channels (0.0148, 0.00887, 0.01263, 0.00847) vs normal refs (~0.0004-0.0015) and misalignment refs (~0.0003-0.0011), with low 2x (0.00033-0.00251) and very low 3x (0.00021-0.00035). This 1x-dominant pattern matches labelled unbalance trials e.g. 1x 0.0130/0.0081/0.0119/0.0071 with 2x ~0.0017-0.0027 and 0.0154/0.0089/0.0130/0.0086, unlike misalignment where 2x dominates on ch0/ch2 ~0.011-0.015 with low 1x, and unlike normal where both 1x and 2x are low. Crest ~4.0-6.4 and kurtosis ~3.2-3.4 also align with unbalance refs. Limitation: radial-only short recording cannot fully exclude looseness which also shows high 1x, but looseness refs tend to show higher 2x and 3x (e.g. 3x up to 0.0042, 2x up to 0.0070) not seen here.
